customer_persona: Compact-SUV shoppers comparing driving choices, passenger and luggage space, comfort features and ownership costs. Their personal priorities, daily route, location, budget and household remain unknown until they volunteer them.
decision_frame: The strongest fit is the engine and trim whose gearbox, seating and equipment match what you need, and the thing still to verify is that exact version’s current on-road quote.
takeaway: Choose the engine and trim together, then confirm the features and current on-road cost of that exact version.
primary_outcome: Identify an engine-and-trim combination to check against the buyer’s actual needs.
supporting_outcomes: Understand the supported seating, comfort and assistance choices.
Separate the current quote and missing evidence from the features already established.

concerns.why: The separate engines have different gearbox pairings, while actual performance and fuel-use measurements are absent.
The seat arrangement supports flexibility but the sources cannot establish personal passenger, luggage or parking fit.
Standard airbags and selected-trim assistance are different equipment choices and do not establish a crash rating.
The conflicting dated entry price is not a current local on-road quote, and petrol extended warranty is separately paid.
Fuel-economy measurements, service costs and resale evidence are not supplied.

usps.name: Make space for people and bags

segments.title: The gearbox you use every day
segments.goal: MOMENT — Begin with the CRETA’s supported manual-or-automatic choice for the petrol and diesel engines, without a second greeting or a claimed driving benefit. SPOKEN / DEEPER — One 30-word batch uses F003, F008 and F009 to explain choosing a manual gearbox or an automatic subject to engine and trim, with the complete transmission specifications held for deeper answers. VISUAL / HANDOFF — Open on the manual lever and console in im_pdf_df8fadffe78c7af4bbc1, the literal example of the manual choice rather than proof of an automatic selector, and leave the gearbox choice in focus with no checkin.

segments.title: Your gears, seating and airbags
segments.goal: MOMENT — Give exactly three memorable anchors and say that the buyer can steer by interrupting, without asking another question. SPOKEN / DEEPER — One 33-word batch names the three reviewed USPs using F003/F005/F006/F008/F009, F022/F023 and F025, retaining that gearbox choice depends on engine and trim and the turbo is automatic-only. VISUAL / HANDOFF — Start on the manual lever im_pdf_df8fadffe78c7af4bbc1, change to the boot with sample bags im_pdf_06dc900e0519722a9b8a for storage context and the cabin panorama im_pdf_f422a4dec2ba86f0f22f for occupant context, never presenting the latter two as folded-seat or airbag proof, and leave the seating area in focus with an empty checkin.
segments.outcome: Pick the buying choice that matters

segments.title: The wheels beneath the body

VISUAL / HANDOFF — Start on the whole side profile im_pdf_f9bbe411c2dac4280a3e where both wheels can be located, use im_pdf_654ca5b2d4cb084d4a92 only as additional whole-car context, and leave the body and cabin above the wheels as the next subject, with no checkin and no claim that the photographed wheel identifies every option.
segments.outcome: Choose wheel style without assuming comfort

voice.persona_description: The guide is a warm, practical product guide who follows the buyer’s attention. The guide explains one useful thought at a time and says plainly which answers still need evidence.
voice.tone: Cheerful and attentive Indian English, with short connected thoughts, restrained pauses and no pressure.
voice.sample_line: Hi, welcome to the Hyundai CRETA; would you like to share what you’re looking for in your next car, or shall we get started?

visual_gaps.what: Non-turbo petrol engine, automatic gear controls and paddle shifters
visual_gaps.why: The available engine illustrations depict turbo petrol and diesel only, and the manual lever cannot stand in for the missing mechanisms.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload labelled photographs of the non-turbo engine, each automatic selector and paddles on identified trims, plus the complete current engine/gearbox matrix.

visual_gaps.what: Identified wheel options, clearance and suspension evidence
visual_gaps.why: Whole-car images show wheels but cannot identify every option or establish ground clearance, suspension specification or measured rough-road comfort.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload labelled wheel/tyre close-ups, the official dimension/suspension tables and a documented road test with trim, tyres and surfaces.

visual_gaps.what: Split rear seat folding and rear recline operation
visual_gaps.why: The boot photo and cabin panorama are contextual for F021–F024; no supplied image shows either mechanism operating.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload an identified rear-seat folding sequence and a clear view of the reclining seatback and adjustment control.

visual_gaps.what: Rear vents, shades, rear armrest and measured luggage/seat space
visual_gaps.why: The panorama does not establish those individual details, boot litres, rear legroom or parking dimensions.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload feature close-ups and the official capacity/dimension tables; use an in-person check for the buyer’s own passengers, bags and parking.

visual_gaps.what: Airbags and other safety mechanisms beyond lane detection
visual_gaps.why: The cabin panorama is context only, while the supplied safety diagram shows lane detection rather than airbags, brakes, stability control, hill-start operation, tyre-pressure display, sensors or camera views.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload the manufacturer’s airbag diagram and labelled images or demonstrations of each safety feature to be explained.

visual_gaps.why: Equipment specifications and a lane illustration cannot establish measured crash performance for the exact model and year.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload the matching official crash-test report and the manufacturer’s body safety documentation.

visual_gaps.what: Separate temperature settings, phone mirroring, adapter, Alexa and seat-memory controls
visual_gaps.why: The dashboard picture does not literally show these detailed settings or connected functions and must remain contextual.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload a climate-panel close-up, a compatible phone connected to the display, the required SX-and-above adapter, and identified Alexa and memory-control examples.

visual_gaps.what: Sound system and cooled glove box
visual_gaps.why: The roof and dashboard pictures do not show Bose equipment or glove-box cooling.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload labelled sound-system and subwoofer views and a close-up of glove-box cooling on identified trims.

visual_gaps.what: Measured seat cooling, performance and fuel-use results
visual_gaps.why: The seat-airflow and engine illustrations do not establish cooldown time, acceleration, loaded climbing, economy, smoothness or noise.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Supply official engine/gearbox fuel-economy certification and identified instrumented tests with the relevant load, environment and method.

visual_gaps.why: No supplied image shows the conflicting entry-price figures, a current quote or policy terms; exterior images are contextual only.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload a reconciled current official price listing, an itemised local engine/trim quote and standard/paid extended-warranty documents.

visual_gaps.what: Service, resale, stock, delivery and usable booking evidence
visual_gaps.why: The registry cannot establish local service cost/access, future resale, current availability or a working test-drive booking route.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Obtain the official service schedule/locator, local maintenance estimate, documented comparable resale data where needed, dealer stock/delivery confirmation and a verified booking destination.

visual_gaps.why: No approved fact establishes this category-library feature.
visual_gaps.suggestion: Upload an official trim-availability entry and matching cabin photo before mentioning ambient lighting.

intake.q1: Hi, welcome to the Hyundai CRETA; would you like to share what you’re looking for in your next car, or shall we get started?

do_not_recommend_if: Do not recommend a particular version while a non-negotiable requirement depends on missing fuel-economy, safety-test, personal-fit, price or availability evidence.
advance: When the buyer is ready to verify a version, name Request dealer contact so the selected Hyundai dealer can confirm the engine and trim and provide a current itemised on-road quotation; the app records the contact preference and optional follow-up, not completed contact or a booking.
notes: Seven required Coach stops remain intact and ordered, and all three USP objects are copied exactly; no playbook version was supplied. Guided word allocation totals 427: powertrain 31+31+30, wheels 27, space 33, safety 31+31, cabin 31+32, delighters 31+31, price 29, supplemental armrest storage 26, and establish 33. These 14 main batches each stay within 26–33 words; adding the separate 23-word Explore overview and 45-word closing reaches the full 495-word target. Supplemental storage counts as space’s second batch and establish as ownership’s second, so every library stop remains at most two except powertrain’s three. The Browse intro/outcome are separate at 30 and 33 words. Only the final fit summary and CTA receive closing statements, within the 45-word allowance; all segment checkins stay empty. Reordered batches stand alone and vary their opening through a visible detail, situation, choice or honest limit. Features and establish voice disjoint facts rather than repeating proof claims. The registry alone supports claims; supplied PDF images are visual context, with missing literal mechanisms explicitly flagged. No measured performance, comfort, safety or financial result is inferred. Technical quantities retain complete units and basis in deeper answers; the conflicting dated entry price remains a qualified deeper answer. Unknown customer context remains unknown, and the final summary names no preferred trim before the buyer supplies a reason. Retain configured Sarvam Priya; all CTAs are empty-URL contact requests because the source supplied no action destination.
